description: This file defines an abstract class 'Command' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Framework\Console'. The class extends Symfony's base command class and provides utility methods to set up input/output interfaces, primarily for console command implementations within the OrangeHRM project. It includes mechanisms to initialize and access a SymfonyStyle object for consistent console styling and output, and mandates subclasses to define their command name.
